BiblicalUsage: Corruption is the decay of the grave, and Peter's sermon turns on it. David saw corruption, but Christ did not, because God would not leave His Holy One to see it, and the promise is that the same God who raised Him will raise us.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the empty tomb is the answer to corruption. Death decays everything it touches, but it could not hold the Holy One, and His rising is the pledge that my own body will not be left to decay forever.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
